entities.name: Regina Guimarães
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Regina Guimarães, also known as Corbe, is a Portuguese poet, playwright, stage director and lyricist. She lives and works with her partner, Sergei Saguenail Abramovici a.k.a. Saguenail, since 1975. The couple founded the publishing house Hélastre.
